citation: Howell, D.E., and Butler, J.R., 1977, Preliminary geologic map of Chesterfield County (Patrick, Cash, Angelus, Chesterfield, Lake Robinson, Mt. Croghan, Ruby, Morven West, Pageland, and Middendorf 7.5 minute quadrangles): South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-17, map scale 1:100,000.
notes: OFR-17 Chesterfield County preliminary geology (Butler and Howell, 1977): plate 1 (1:100,000) and plate 2 (digital 1:62,500 with explanation, recorded here).
